github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text:
Generate commit messages using this EXACT format — no exceptions:

Version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCHLVL Build BUILDNUMBER
Title
+ [Subsystem] Description
~ [Subsystem] Description
- [Subsystem] Description

STEP 1: Find version.hpp in the diff (or read it). Extract MISC_MAJOR, MISC_MINOR, MISC_PATCHLVL, MISC_BUILD. The very first line of the commit message must be: Version MISC_MAJOR.MISC_MINOR.MISC_PATCHLVL Build MISC_BUILD

STEP 2: Write one change per line. Each line MUST start with +, ~, or - followed by a subsystem name in square brackets, then a description. The subsystem label is a short name like [HMD], [AI System], [CfgWeapons], [Core], [Medical] — NEVER a filename.

DO NOT write: ~ Adjusted heading scale (kimi_hmd_ghost_hawk.hpp)
DO write:     ~ [HMD] Adjusted heading number scale and position

Correct example:
Version 3.3.0 Build 270526
Updated HMD and AI Systems
~ [HMD] Adjusted heading number scale and position
~ [HMD] Updated CCIP weapon display and rocket sight dimensions
~ [AI System] Updated helicopter combat mode and engagement logic
+ [Docs] Added comprehensive Ghost Hawk HMD reference
